exposure: abnormal levels of pregnancy associated plasma protein (PAPP-A)
abnormal levels of first trimester human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG)
abnormal levels of second trimester human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG)
cohort: The study included 357 dichorionic/diamniotic and 123 monochorionic/diamniotic twin pregnancies delivered at a tertiary care hospital between 2009 and 2017.
finding: Selected abnormal levels of alpha fetoprotein and inhibin were associated with increased rates of preterm delivery and/or pregnancy-associated hypertension in twin pregnancies, with specific associations differing by chorionicity.
